name: Home-Style Chicken Curry
steps: Heat the oil and fry the chopped onion until deep golden.
Add the tomato, yogurt and spices, cooking into a thick masala.
Add the raw chicken pieces and stir to coat.
Pour in water, cover, and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and no longer pink inside.
Uncover and reduce the sauce, then finish with fresh coriander.
